## Grading

| Component | Weight | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Reading quizzes | 5% | drop 4 |
| Class participation (clickers) | 5% | attending 80+% of class gets you full credit |
| Homework | 10% | drop 1 |
| Projects | 25% |  |
| Midterm 1 | 15% |  |
| Midterm 2 | 15% | Likely an oral exam |
| Final | 25% | Tuesday Dec. 8, 7:30-10:00PM |


## Missing class

No need to notify me — the grading structure above allows for you to miss some class with no penalty.

## Late policy

You begin the semester with 3 tokens that can be used for a 48-hour extension on any homework assignment or individual project. That is, you have the opportunity to submit three assignments late with no penalty. Once you have used those three tokens, late work receives a zero.
